confidence_notes: Low overall. Restaurant meal anchors rest on Florianopolis price points from search snippets of aggregator sites (Expatistan, GlobalCostData, MyLifeElsewhere). GlobalCostData reports a June 2026 update and Traveltables a 2023 one. BRL is converted at an assumed rate of roughly R$5.2 per USD, not a verified live rate. Beer rests on one Expatistan neighbourhood-pub estimate. No direct cappuccino price was found, so coffee is a model estimate. Cocktail and wine use the local beer-relationship basis (cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine about 1.5x beer), with a blog range of $7-10 for signature cocktails and glasses of wine (currency unstated) as a loose check. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026, the mid-year school-holiday period, and were not checked against live listings or availability. FX: the most recent RBA figure I could retrieve is 0.7088 as at 4.00 pm on 20 March 2026. That is stale relative to the 19 November 2026 generation date. The latest RBA F11.1 value was not retrieved, and later-dated aggregator figures were not used because they are not RBA sources.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was verified. Restaurant anchors come from Florianopolis-specific aggregator price points. Drink and accommodation anchors use general Brazilian coastal-tourism pricing judgement, with no comparable-city benchmark applied.
